statement_summary: Documented program benchmarked against NIST CSF 2.0
Information Security Officer designated in writing
Annual enterprise risk assessment using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority; payday and credential risks capped
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions
Sanctions, including credential sharing
Vendor gate: security review and terms before Restricted data
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 vendors
Annual independent assessment
Six-year retention of security records
AI tools approved before use; hiring AI is High tier
Secure development for firm-written code
Change control for pay, I-9, credential, and AI settings
Unique accounts; no shared logins including E-Verify and kiosks
Restricted access groups for I-9, consumer reports, medical information, SSNs
SSO and MFA; phishing-resistant for payroll and admins; no SMS where pay can change
Same-day removal in every system at termination
Prior-role access removed within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews; monthly E-Verify reconciliation; client user reviews
Payroll separation of duties and bank-change verification
Lockout, idle lock, and kiosk session reset
Break-glass accounts tested quarterly
API keys and service accounts in the secrets service, scoped, rotated
Separate administrator accounts and just-in-time elevation
Remote and vendor access with MFA and session approval
Client and supplier users owned, with MFA
Incident plan and runbooks for payroll breach and payroll outage
Immediate reporting within 1 hour
Log, categorize, and track incidents; pay diversion is an incident
MSSP 30-minute escalation; severity 1 to the COO within 1 hour
Breach determination and decision log
Notices per the matrix (DHS immediately, MSP clients 48 hours, 30 days Florida)
regulatory_driver: Fla. Stat. 501.171(3)-(5); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.16

statement_summary: Pay continuity within 1 business day; manual payroll
Extortion payment requires CEO, counsel, insurer, OFAC check
Annual tabletop per runbook; annual role training
Lessons learned within 30 days
Contingency plan from the BIA; quarterly restores; annual exercise
Logs to the SIEM with payroll and download alerts
Four-level classification
Encryption at rest and in transit
Approved locations only; no email or file shares for Restricted data
Minimization: last 4 digits; SSNs by IVR keypad
Data inventory reviewed quarterly
Retention schedule with quarterly purges
Certified disposal of paper and devices
Encrypted, separate, write-once backups including the archive; quarterly restores
Medical information in separate confidential files
Biometric notice, consent, and alternative before enrollment
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools
Business use of firm systems
Signed acknowledgment at hire and yearly
Annual awareness training; quarterly phishing including push relay
Annual role training for payroll, onboarding, credentialing, recruiters, MSP
regulatory_driver: N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(g)(1)(iii)); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.5

statement_summary: SSO-only payroll sign-in; report unexpected MFA prompts
Never share passwords, approvals, or E-Verify credentials
Lock screens; no records left on kiosks
No unapproved software or USB storage
Report lost devices and suspicious requests
Approved AI tools only; AI is a sort aid, never sole rejection
Recording announcement on every recorded call
Follow client site rules; return badges
